text: Wall Street is betting the Fed hikes again in December.
In September, it hiked for the first time since 2023.
Then October inflation came in hot.
Markets now price about ninety percent odds of a hike on December ninth.
Why do stocks care? Higher rates shrink what future profits are worth today.
A hundred dollars, ten years out, is worth seventy-four today at three percent. At five percent? Sixty-one.
That's why long-duration growth stocks feel it first.
